_comment: Per-agent config for the background-*-digest family. Generated from this template by update.sh (only-if-absent) into ~/.claude-data/config/digest-config.json. Edit the TEMPLATE (committed), not the generated file. Each machine reads its own agent block, keyed by the lowercased agent name from ~/.claude-data/agent/identity.json. github_user is the GitHub login used for review-request matching and as the Jira/PR author.

pr-digest._comment: Read-only GitHub PR surveillance. repos = owner/repo list. output: 'queue' (local digest-queue.jsonl) for local runs; a cloud routine must use 'issue' or 'runlog'.

sprint-digest._comment: Read-only Jira sprint-staleness. NO repos/project block — the JQL (assignee=currentUser() AND sprint in openSprints()) self-scopes to the user's active sprint. Only output + cron vary per agent.

merge-progression._comment: WRITE-CAPABLE: transitions Jira tickets. cloud_allowed:false hard-blocks cloud-routine creation — a write-capable skill must not run unattended from a sandbox. Runs LOCAL ONLY.
